subject: Why two legends when I try change legend.title using colour = "XXX"

messages.author: a9413cb4eedc9e12
messages.subject: Why two legends when I try change legend.title using colour = "XXX"
parts:
I am trying to change a legend title but instead get the legend repeated once in colour and once in black and white.
Presumably the legend is not from colour but where is it coming from?  I know I can get around the problem by changing the variable name but I would prefer to know what I am missing.

Any suggestions ?

Data below code

#====================Start code======================================
library(gplot2)
p  <-  ggplot(dat1, aes(station, mean, 
            colour = syear, group = syear,
                          shape = syear))+
                           geom_point() + 
                          geom_line(aes(linetype=syear))
p                                                          # as exected

p1  <-  p + labs(colour  = "Year") # where is that coming from?
p1

#====================Start  data======================================
dat1  <-  structure(list(station = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L,
3L, 3L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 4L), .Label = c("B1", "H2", "H3", "H4"), class = "factor"),
    syear = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 1L,
    2L, 3L), .Label = c("2007", "2008", "2009"), class = "factor"),
    mean = c(289.271, 312.147, 308.975555555556, 310.25, 323.344,
    311.016666666667, 333.118, 371.817, 335.452, 371.443, 418.147,
    358.273), sdv = c(41.3949826401434, 20.1604233035365, 82.0000085535226,
    28.8646007728806, 16.5425237897164, 17.8610085101598, 23.2581358763862,
    27.8877950405231, 16.8357462297075, 21.5245756442878, 31.8989714393566,
    16.5014545150151), se = c(25.6568760538128, 12.4955598215331,
    53.5733389216347, 17.8904649099768, 10.2531624709127, 11.6691922266377,
    14.4155419658151, 17.2850344446081, 10.4349036221157, 13.341070202089,
    19.7711873339452, 10.2277074707309)), .Names = c("station",
"syear", "mean", "sdv", "se"), row.names = c(10L, 11L, 12L, 24L,
25L, 26L, 38L, 39L, 40L, 52L, 53L, 54L), class = "data.frame")

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Why two legends when I try change legend.title using colour = "XXX"
parts:
Hi John,

Legends will only be merged if they have the same label. You need

p + labs(colour = "Year", shape="Year", linetype="Year")

Best,
Ista

messages.subject: Re: Why two legends when I try change legend.title using colour = "XXX"
parts:
Never mind.  Denis Murphy response in Changing Legend Title on Ggplot 0.9.3 duplicates Legend and Color Scale shows how to handle it.  I had tried something similar but not gone far enough.

the last line of code should read:
pl1  <-  p +labs(color = "Year", shape = "Year", group = "Year",
                   linetype = "Year")

Thanks Denis.

th
